title: provable-ladder SKIP is reported as section success, so a gate that requires it passes without a ladder run
evidence: measured 2026-09-28 (a2): PR-2 #4588 run 36393949812 x86-main job 108835851305 logs 'section provable-ladder: success in 5s' next to 'SKIP (no verdict, not a pass): crates/aprender-contracts-staging/discharge-summary.json is not tracked'. ci/sections.yml provable-ladder skip() writes step output skip=true and exits 0; the section declares no outputs:, so fat_driver.py records result=success and verdict() (scripts/ci/fat_driver.py:1266) also passes 'skipped'. Adding X86:provable-ladder to the gate's for-pair list would be green with no Lean run.
ask: Before the ladder becomes required: provable-ladder declares outputs skip + skip_reason (ci/sections.yml) and the ci.yml gate accepts a skip ONLY for the Thm 15 path filter (no ladder input changed); 'summary not tracked' or a decline = FAIL. Same shape as the #3668 docs-only rule. ci.yml edit = operator check-in.

title: discharge-summary.json axioms_ok/escapes_ok are bools that fold 'never ran' into False
evidence: read 2026-09-28 (a2): axioms_ok = axioms_fresh==Some(true) && lake_exit==Some(0); escapes_ok = escapes_ok==Some(true).
